### Headline summary
- OpenAI faces a security breach as an employee is arrested for leaking confidential device plans to Apple. ([Techmeme](https://www.techmeme.com/261013/p49#a261013p49), [NYT > Technology](https://www.nytimes.com/2026/10/13/technology/openai-worker-arrested-bugging.html))
- Major model releases include Google's Gemini 4 Argon, xAI's Grok Voice 3.0, and Liquid AI's LFM2.5-24B-A2B. ([Latent Space](https://www.latent.space/p/ainews-ai-engineer-nyc-gemini-4-argon), [Venelin Valkov](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=gdNuk4DS-m4), [Unite.AI](https://www.unite.ai/xai-introduces-grok-voice-3-0-speech-to-speech-model-for-voice-agents/), [Techmeme](https://www.techmeme.com/261014/p38#a261014p38))
- Character.ai filed for Chapter 11 bankruptcy following a $2.7 billion deal with Google. ([Hacker News (AI tag)](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/10/13/character-ai-chapter-11-disney-bid.html), [Analytics India Magazine](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=z_i9bWQoGFE))

### OpenAI employee arrested for leaking confidential device plans
An OpenAI employee was arrested for planting a hidden recording device and allegedly stealing unreleased device files for Apple, leading to the leak of confidential plans. ([Techmeme](https://www.techmeme.com/261013/p49#a261013p49), [NYT > Technology](https://www.nytimes.com/2026/10/13/technology/openai-worker-arrested-bugging.html), [Bloomberg Technology](https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2026-10-14/apple-openai-head-to-court-in-high-stakes-ai-trade-secret-fight), [TechSpot](https://www.techspot.com/news/114196-openai-employee-arrested-allegedly-hiding-recording-device-executive.html))

### Character.ai files for Chapter 11 bankruptcy
Character.ai filed for Chapter 11 bankruptcy following a $2.7 billion deal with Google, with Disney reportedly making a bid and regulators investigating the company's data practices. ([Hacker News (AI tag)](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/10/13/character-ai-chapter-11-disney-bid.html), [Analytics India Magazine](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=z_i9bWQoGFE), [404 Media](https://www.404media.co/character-ai-bankruptcy-is-first-ai-bubble-domino-to-fall/), [The Verge](https://www.theverge.com/policy/1011417/new-york-ag-characterai-bankruptcy))

### Google releases Gemini 4 Argon model
Google released the Gemini 4 Argon model, highlighting its capabilities for agentic and scientific tasks. ([Latent Space](https://www.latent.space/p/ainews-ai-engineer-nyc-gemini-4-argon), [Venelin Valkov](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=gdNuk4DS-m4), [Tech Monitor](https://www.techmonitor.ai/news/google-launches-gemini-4-argon-for-complex-coding-and-science-tasks), [Prompt Engineering](https://www.youtube.com/shorts/YVV9csOi770))

### Nvidia pledges investment in Europe amid AI demand
Nvidia pledged $2 billion for Europe and $250 million for UK AI safety, while ASML reported capacity constraints and stock gains driven by high AI demand. ([Bloomberg Technology](https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2026-10-14/asml-raises-full-year-sales-outlook-as-ai-boom-drives-demand), [Unite.AI](https://www.unite.ai/asml-warns-2027-2028-chip-tool-output-will-fall-short-of-ai-demand/), [Silicon RepublicSilicon Republic](https://www.siliconrepublic.com/business/ai-led-demand-overwhelms-asmls-2027-2028-supply-capacity), [Artificial intelligence (AI)](https://www.theguardian.com/technology/2026/oct/14/nvidia-donates-to-uk-ai-safety-research))

### Apple launches HomeView smart display and HomePod mini 2
Apple launched its first smart display, the $299 HomeView, and the HomePod mini 2 with Siri AI, with sales starting in November and early discounts available at Amazon. ([gHacks Technology News](https://www.ghacks.net/2026/10/14/apple-launches-the-299-homeview-its-first-smart-display-with-sales-starting-november-13/), [Computerworld](https://www.computerworld.com/article/4235207/china-clears-alibabas-qwen-ai-just-in-time-for-iphone-duo.html), [TechSpot](https://www.techspot.com/news/114193-apple-unveils-homepod-mini-2-siri-ai-faster.html), [Engadget](https://www.engadget.com/2286617/alibaba-ai-models-cleared-for-use-in-apple-intelligence-in-china-just-in-time-for-the-iphone-duo-launch/))

### xAI releases Grok Voice 3.0 speech-to-speech model
xAI announced Grok Voice 3.0, a speech-to-speech model available in its API that claims to top industry benchmarks and respond in under a second. ([Unite.AI](https://www.unite.ai/xai-introduces-grok-voice-3-0-speech-to-speech-model-for-voice-agents/), [Techmeme](https://www.techmeme.com/261014/p38#a261014p38))

### Concerns over AI infrastructure debt and financial stability
The IMF warned of global financial contagion risks from an AI sector wipeout, while CoreWeave's stock dropped and bond yields rose due to concerns over heavy borrowing for AI build-outs. ([Techmeme](https://www.techmeme.com/261014/p36#a261014p36), [Hacker News (AI tag)](https://www.tomshardware.com/tech-industry/big-tech/the-imf-highlights-how-a-financial-wipeout-in-the-ai-sector-could-become-a-global-contagion-agency-report-shines-light-on-circular-economics-and-leveraged-loans))

### Scientists call for international AI containment oversight
Geoffrey Hinton, Yoshua Bengio, and over 400 other scientists signed an open letter calling for an international body to oversee AI containment standards and incident reporting. ([Techmeme](https://www.techmeme.com/261013/p53#a261013p53), [Silicon RepublicSilicon Republic](https://www.siliconrepublic.com/enterprise/geoffrey-hinton-among-415-scientists-calling-for-joint-effort-for-ai-safety))
